text:
Felix (Partnerships): Quick ping: Partner / ApexMarkets is changing SKU identifiers next week (old_sku -> canonical_sku). They want marketplace reports unchanged for customers. Need mapping plan.

Ivy - Marketplace: Do they provide a mapping file or just a rename? If it's a rename we can canonicalize on ingest.

Rita (Integrations): They're sending a CSV mapping and will include a mapping_version header in files. Plan: ingest stores original_sku and resolved_canonical_sku, plus mapping_version. We should not backfill historically unless partner requests.

Chen (Billing): Important: preserve invoice continuity. Rule: invoice lines group by canonical_sku at billing time. Keep raw_partner_sku for trace. If mapping_version changes mid-billing-cycle, tie events to mapping_version used at ingest and surface any remap as adjustments.

Ivy - Marketplace: Small implementation note: add columns canonical_sku and mapping_version to ingestion table; add index on (partner_id, canonical_sku, utc_day).

Rita (Integrations): We'll provide a 14-day sandbox with both old and new skus and mapping CSV. Also include a sample of overlapping mapping_version to test remap handling.

Felix (Partnerships): Owners: Rita deliver sandbox, Ivy PR for schema + index, Chen update billing runbook. Quick sync in 1h to confirm.

atlas-ingest-bot: Alert: schema-change-preview for ApexMarkets mapping arriving 2026-10-12T04:00:00Z. Monitor mapping_conflicts and unmapped_sku_rate for 72h.

Chen (Billing): One last ask: add an audit field mapping_source (partner|manual) so Partner Ops can annotate forced overrides.

Felix (Partnerships): Nice catch. Adding that to the owners list. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
